executive_summary.description: A high-level summary of the key findings regarding arts discovery, digital equity, and technical infrastructure in Richmond, VA.

broadband_adoption_analysis.description: Analysis of broadband adoption rates in Richmond ZIP codes 23222, 23223, and 23224, and an assessment of whether web-only arts discovery models risk excluding residents in these neighborhoods.

zip_code.description: The 5-digit ZIP code for the area.

neighborhood_name.description: The common name for the neighborhood(s) covered by the ZIP code (e.g., Northside, East End).

broadband_subscription_rate_percent.description: The percentage of households within the ZIP code that have a broadband internet subscription.

data_source.description: The source of the data, including the specific survey and year (e.g., ACS 2022 5-Year Estimates).

broadband_data_by_zip_code.description: Specific broadband adoption rate data for the requested Richmond ZIP codes. Each entry should detail the ZIP code, the percentage of households with a broadband internet subscription, and the data source (e.g., ACS 2022 5-Year Estimates).

arts_attendance_data_availability.description: An assessment of whether Richmond has neighborhood-level data on arts event attendance broken down by race, income, or age, and clarification on whether the Richmond 300 survey is the only available proxy.

language_requirements_for_inclusion.description: Identifies languages beyond English and Spanish needed for inclusive arts discovery in Richmond, based on data about local immigrant and refugee communities. Includes languages such as Dari, Pashto, and Arabic.

information_channels_for_seniors.description: An overview of how elderly Richmond residents (65+) currently learn about arts and cultural events, covering channels like print media, radio, community newsletters, and word-of-mouth.

platform_name.description: The name of the national arts aggregator platform being analyzed.

key_features.description: A summary of the platform's core features, such as community guides, RSVP functionality, or user-driven demand.

engagement_drivers.description: An analysis of the features or strategies that successfully drove sustained user engagement.

failure_factors.description: For discontinued models like Eventful's 'Demand It!', an analysis of the factors that led to its failure or discontinuation.

national_arts_aggregator_models_analysis.description: An analysis of national arts aggregator models, including ArtRabbit, DoStuff, and the former Eventful 'Demand It!' feature. Each entry will detail the platform, its key features, and factors that drove or hindered sustained user engagement.

issue_summary.description: A summary of the technical issue observed on the CultureWorks calendar.

platform_provider.description: The name of the third-party software provider for the calendar, identified as Localist.

error_message.description: The specific error message found, such as 'Liquid syntax error: Cannot build json - ld tag'.

implication.description: The potential impact of this error on search engine optimization (SEO) and event data discoverability.

event_syndication_tool_feasibility.description: An analysis of the feasibility and potential for a 'submit-once, route-many' event submission tool for Richmond arts organizers to syndicate event listings across multiple platforms like VisitRichmond, Venture Richmond, and Style Weekly.

organization_name.description: The name of the organization that hosts the event calendar (e.g., Visit Richmond, Venture Richmond).

portal_name.description: The name or title of the event calendar.

submission_url.description: The direct URL to the event submission form or page.

richmond_event_submission_portals.description: A list of the primary event calendar submission portals for organizations in Richmond, VA, including their names and a brief note on their function.

organization_name.description: The name of the organization supporting immigrant and refugee communities.

primary_focus.description: The main services or focus of the organization, such as refugee resettlement, health services, or education.

languages_supported.description: A list of key languages, besides English and Spanish, that are relevant to the communities served by the organization (e.g., Dari, Pashto, Arabic).

key_immigrant_support_organizations.description: A list of key organizations in Richmond that support immigrant and refugee communities, providing insight into the linguistic and cultural diversity of the area. Includes organizations like ReEstablish Richmond and Sacred Heart Center.

digital_divide_impact_on_arts_access.description: A broader analysis of how the digital divide, encompassing both broadband access and language barriers, impacts equitable access to arts and culture discovery in Richmond.

recommendations_for_inclusive_arts_disco.description: Actionable recommendations for arts organizations in Richmond to improve the equity and inclusivity of their event discovery process, based on the report's findings.
